meta.name: browser-use
meta.description: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.

copy.tagline: 用代码直接操控浏览器完成网页自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器执行点击、填表、截图等操作
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser programmatically for web automation and testing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions like clicking, form filling, and screenshots

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能直接控制浏览器，自动执行网页操作，如填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取数据等。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 在浏览器中完成某项任务时触发，例如“帮我查一下这个网站的信息”或“自动登录并截图”。

say.text: 打开百度，搜索“天气”，并截图搜索结果。
帮我自动登录 Gmail，然后截取收件箱页面。
say.note: Claude 会尝试自动登录，若遇到密码输入会暂停询问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly control the browser to automate web tasks such as filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, and extracting data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to perform a task in the browser, e.g., "check this website" or "automate login and screenshot."

say_en.text: Open Baidu, search for "weather", and screenshot the results.
Auto-login to Gmail and screenshot the inbox.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt auto-login; if password is needed, it will pause and ask.
